changes.comment: Report live activity through one agent-keyed sink: the native-turn sink is gone and a turn end is emitted as a `turn.ended` activity carrying codex's own error text. The per-turn pending-activity buffer is deleted, so thread items observed before a submission binds are reported instead of buffered and possibly dropped; orphan turns are still released from the collector. No config, state, or path shape changed and no rebuild is required.
